// Package diagnosticfixture owns the deterministic Course content used by the
// isolated V2 diagnostic bootstrap verification. It deliberately does not
// contain a learner attempt, answer payload, or placement state.
package diagnosticfixture

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/course"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	moduleuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/module"
	sectionuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/section"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/task"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// ErrDrift means an existing fixture conflicts with the versioned contract.
var ErrDrift = errors.New("diagnostic assessment fixture drift")

//go:embed fixture.v1.json
var fixtureFiles embed.FS

var slugPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,254}$`)

type Text struct {
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

type LessonText struct {
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Excerpt     string `json:"excerpt"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

type IDs struct {
	Course  string `json:"course"`
	Module  string `json:"module"`
	Section string `json:"section"`
	Lesson  string `json:"lesson"`
}

type LearningTarget struct {
	Type    string `json:"type"`
	Key     string `json:"key"`
	Version string `json:"version"`
}

type Variant struct {
	ID        string `json:"id"`
	SourceKey string `json:"source_key"`
	Order     int    `json:"order"`
	IsCorrect bool   `json:"is_correct"`
	EN        string `json:"en"`
	RU        string `json:"ru"`
}

type Question struct {
	ID        string    `json:"id"`
	SourceKey string    `json:"source_key"`
	Kind      string    `json:"kind"`
	Order     int       `json:"order"`
	EN        Text      `json:"en"`
	RU        Text      `json:"ru"`
	Variants  []Variant `json:"variants"`
}

type FixtureTask struct {
	ID                     string           `json:"id"`
	SourceKey              string           `json:"source_key"`
	Type                   string           `json:"type"`
	AssessmentPurpose      string           `json:"assessment_purpose"`
	ExecutionMode          string           `json:"execution_mode"`
	EvaluationMode         string           `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	UIMode                 string           `json:"ui_mode"`
	SubmissionMode         string           `json:"submission_mode"`
	RequiresSandbox        bool             `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview         bool             `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal        bool             `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation bool             `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	EN                     Text             `json:"en"`
	RU                     Text             `json:"ru"`
	LearningTargets        []LearningTarget `json:"learning_targets"`
	Tests                  []Question       `json:"tests"`
}

// Definition is the source-owned, versioned V2 diagnostic content contract.
type Definition struct {
	FixtureID      string                `json:"fixture_id"`
	FixtureVersion int                   `json:"fixture_version"`
	Slug           string                `json:"slug"`
	IDs            IDs                   `json:"ids"`
	Languages      []string              `json:"languages"`
	Course         map[string]Text       `json:"course"`
	Module         map[string]Text       `json:"module"`
	Section        map[string]Text       `json:"section"`
	Lesson         map[string]LessonText `json:"lesson"`
	Tasks          []FixtureTask         `json:"tasks"`
}

// LoadDefinition loads the embedded versioned content contract.
func LoadDefinition() (Definition, error) {
	raw, err := fixtureFiles.ReadFile("fixture.v1.json")
	if err != nil {
		return Definition{}, err
	}
	var definition Definition
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &definition); err != nil {
		return Definition{}, err
	}
	if err := definition.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Definition{}, err
	}
	return definition, nil
}

func (d Definition) Validate() error {
	if d.FixtureID != "diagnostic_assessment_smoke" || d.FixtureVersion != 1 || d.Slug != "diagnostic-assessment-smoke-v1" || !slugPattern.MatchString(d.Slug) {
		return errors.New("invalid diagnostic fixture identity")
	}
	if len(d.Languages) != 2 || d.Languages[0] != "en" || d.Languages[1] != "ru" {
		return errors.New("diagnostic fixture languages must be en, ru")
	}
	for entity, texts := range map[string]map[string]Text{"course": d.Course, "module": d.Module, "section": d.Section} {
		if err := validateTexts(entity, texts, d.Languages); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if len(d.Lesson) != len(d.Languages) {
		return errors.New("invalid diagnostic lesson translations")
	}
	for _, language := range d.Languages {
		text, ok := d.Lesson[language]
		if !ok || strings.TrimSpace(text.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(text.Excerpt) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(text.Description) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid diagnostic lesson translation for %s", language)
		}
	}

	seenIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
	for name, id := range map[string]string{"course": d.IDs.Course, "module": d.IDs.Module, "section": d.IDs.Section, "lesson": d.IDs.Lesson} {
		if err := rememberID(seenIDs, name, id); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if len(d.Tasks) != 3 {
		return errors.New("diagnostic fixture requires exactly three tasks")
	}
	seenKeys := map[string]struct{}{}
	for taskIndex, item := range d.Tasks {
		if err := rememberID(seenIDs, fmt.Sprintf("task[%d]", taskIndex), item.ID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := rememberSourceKey(seenKeys, item.SourceKey); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("task[%d]: %w", taskIndex, err)
		}
		parsedType, err := domain.ParseTaskType(item.Type)
		if err != nil || parsedType != domain.TaskTypeTest || item.AssessmentPurpose != domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic {
			return fmt.Errorf("task[%d] must be a diagnostic test", taskIndex)
		}
		if item.ExecutionMode != "NO_RUN" || item.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" || item.UIMode != "QUIZ" || item.SubmissionMode != "ANSWER_PAYLOAD" || item.RequiresSandbox || item.ExposesPreview || item.ExposesTerminal || item.SupportsLiveValidation {
			return fmt.Errorf("task[%d] must use the no-run automatic assessment contract", taskIndex)
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(item.EN.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(item.EN.Description) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(item.RU.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(item.RU.Description) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("task[%d] translations are invalid", taskIndex)
		}
		if len(item.LearningTargets) == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("task[%d] requires a learning target", taskIndex)
		}
		if _, err := normalizeTargets(item.LearningTargets); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("task[%d] targets: %w", taskIndex, err)
		}
		if err := validateQuestions(item.Tests, seenIDs, seenKeys); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("task[%d]: %w", taskIndex, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateTexts(entity string, texts map[string]Text, languages []string) error {
	if len(texts) != len(languages) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s translations", entity)
	}
	for _, language := range languages {
		text, ok := texts[language]
		if !ok || strings.TrimSpace(text.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(text.Description) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s translation for %s", entity, language)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func rememberID(seen map[string]struct{}, name, id string) error {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(id); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s id: %w", name, err)
	}
	if _, exists := seen[id]; exists {
		return fmt.Errorf("duplicate deterministic id: %s", name)
	}
	seen[id] = struct{}{}
	return nil
}

func rememberSourceKey(seen map[string]struct{}, key string) error {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(key)
	if err != nil || normalized == "" || normalized != key {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	seen[key] = struct{}{}
	return nil
}

func validateQuestions(questions []Question, seenIDs, seenKeys map[string]struct{}) error {
	if len(questions) == 0 {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	tests := make([]domain.TaskTest, 0, len(questions))
	for questionIndex, question := range questions {
		if err := rememberID(seenIDs, fmt.Sprintf("question[%d]", questionIndex), question.ID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := rememberSourceKey(seenKeys, question.SourceKey); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		variants := make([]domain.TaskTestVariant, 0, len(question.Variants))
		for variantIndex, variant := range question.Variants {
			if err := rememberID(seenIDs, fmt.Sprintf("variant[%d]", variantIndex), variant.ID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := rememberSourceKey(seenKeys, variant.SourceKey); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if strings.TrimSpace(variant.EN) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(variant.RU) == "" {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
			variants = append(variants, domain.TaskTestVariant{ID: variant.ID, SourceKey: variant.SourceKey, Order: variant.Order, IsCorrect: variant.IsCorrect, Translations: []domain.TaskTestVariantI18n{{I18nID: 1, Language: "en", Text: variant.EN}, {I18nID: 2, Language: "ru", Text: variant.RU}}})
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(question.EN.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(question.RU.Title) == "" {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		tests = append(tests, domain.TaskTest{ID: question.ID, SourceKey: question.SourceKey, Kind: question.Kind, Order: question.Order, Variants: variants, Translations: []domain.TaskTestI18n{{I18nID: 1, Language: "en", Title: question.EN.Title, Description: question.EN.Description}, {I18nID: 2, Language: "ru", Title: question.RU.Title, Description: question.RU.Description}}})
	}
	return domain.ValidateTaskAssessments(tests, 0, domain.TaskTestKindSingleChoice)
}

func normalizeTargets(input []LearningTarget) ([]domain.TaskLearningTarget, error) {
	targets := make([]domain.TaskLearningTarget, 0, len(input))
	for _, target := range input {
		targets = append(targets, domain.TaskLearningTarget{Type: domain.LearningTargetType(target.Type), Key: target.Key, Version: target.Version})
	}
	return domain.NormalizeTaskLearningTargets(targets)
}

// Dependencies are the Course-owned repositories used to provision and read
// back the exact diagnostic hierarchy through existing use cases.
type Dependencies struct {
	Tx              repository.TransactionManager
	Courses         repository.CourseRepository
	CourseI18n      repository.CourseI18nRepository
	I18n            repository.I18nRepository
	CodeStructures  repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
	Modules         repository.ModuleRepository
	ModuleI18n      repository.ModuleI18nRepository
	CourseModules   repository.CourseModuleRepository
	Sections        repository.SectionRepository
	SectionI18n     repository.SectionI18nRepository
	ModuleSections  repository.ModuleSectionRepository
	Lessons         repository.LessonRepository
	LessonI18n      repository.LessonI18nRepository
	SectionLessons  repository.SectionLessonRepository
	Tasks           repository.TaskRepository
	TaskI18n        repository.TaskI18nRepository
	TaskTests       repository.TaskTestRepository
	LearningTargets repository.TaskLearningTargetRepository
}

type Provisioner struct {
	Dependencies Dependencies
	Definition   Definition
}

// AssessmentMetadata is deliberately answer-key-free and safe for machine
// readable provisioning evidence.
type AssessmentMetadata struct {
	ID                string                               `json:"id"`
	LessonID          string                               `json:"lesson_id"`
	Type              int16                                `json:"type"`
	AssessmentPurpose string                               `json:"assessment_purpose"`
	EvaluationMode    string                               `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	Order             int                                  `json:"order"`
	Version           int                                  `json:"version"`
	LearningTargets   []task.InternalCourseStructureTarget `json:"learning_targets"`
}

// Result is the only successful CLI payload. It intentionally has no titles,
// question text, variants, answer keys, credentials, or run identifier.
type Result struct {
	Schema             string               `json:"schema"`
	Status             string               `json:"status"`
	FixtureID          string               `json:"fixture_id"`
	FixtureVersion     int                  `json:"fixture_version"`
	CourseID           string               `json:"course_id"`
	CourseSlug         string               `json:"course_slug"`
	CourseActive       bool                 `json:"course_active"`
	CatalogVisible     bool                 `json:"catalog_visible"`
	CurriculumRevision string               `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	Assessments        []AssessmentMetadata `json:"assessments"`
}

const resultSchema = "course-diagnostic-assessment-fixture-result.v1"

// Ensure creates an absent fixture in one transaction, verifies an existing
// fixture without writes, and fails closed when any contract field has drifted.
func (p Provisioner) Ensure(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
	if err := p.validateDependencies(); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if err := p.Definition.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	var result Result
	err := p.Dependencies.Tx.WithTx(ctx, func(txctx repository.Context) error {
		courseRecord, err := p.Dependencies.Courses.GetBySlug(txctx, p.Definition.Slug)
		created := false
		var languageIDs map[string]int
		var structure domain.CodeStructureType
		switch {
		case err == nil:
			languageIDs, err = resolveLanguages(txctx, p.Dependencies.I18n, p.Definition.Languages, false)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			structure, err = resolveTestStructure(txctx, p.Dependencies.CodeStructures, false)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			if err := p.ensureRootIDsAvailable(txctx); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			languageIDs, err = resolveLanguages(txctx, p.Dependencies.I18n, p.Definition.Languages, true)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			structure, err = resolveTestStructure(txctx, p.Dependencies.CodeStructures, true)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := p.createFixture(txctx, languageIDs); err != nil {
				if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
					return drift("identity", "a deterministic fixture identity is already occupied")
				}
				return err
			}
			courseRecord, err = p.Dependencies.Courses.GetBySlug(txctx, p.Definition.Slug)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("read created diagnostic course: %w", err)
			}
			created = true
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic course: %w", err)
		}

		result, err = p.verify(txctx, *courseRecord, languageIDs, structure.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if created {
			result.Status = "created"
		} else {
			result.Status = "already_present"
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (p Provisioner) validateDependencies() error {
	d := p.Dependencies
	if d.Tx == nil || d.Courses == nil || d.CourseI18n == nil || d.I18n == nil || d.CodeStructures == nil || d.Modules == nil || d.ModuleI18n == nil || d.CourseModules == nil || d.Sections == nil || d.SectionI18n == nil || d.ModuleSections == nil || d.Lessons == nil || d.LessonI18n == nil || d.SectionLessons == nil || d.Tasks == nil || d.TaskI18n == nil || d.TaskTests == nil || d.LearningTargets == nil {
		return errors.New("diagnostic fixture dependencies are incomplete")
	}
	return nil
}

func (p Provisioner) ensureRootIDsAvailable(ctx repository.Context) error {
	d := p.Dependencies
	checks := []struct {
		name string
		id   string
		get  func() error
	}{
		{"course", p.Definition.IDs.Course, func() error { _, err := d.Courses.GetByID(ctx, p.Definition.IDs.Course); return err }},
		{"module", p.Definition.IDs.Module, func() error { _, err := d.Modules.Get(ctx, p.Definition.IDs.Module); return err }},
		{"section", p.Definition.IDs.Section, func() error { _, err := d.Sections.Get(ctx, p.Definition.IDs.Section); return err }},
		{"lesson", p.Definition.IDs.Lesson, func() error { _, err := d.Lessons.Get(ctx, p.Definition.IDs.Lesson); return err }},
	}
	for _, item := range p.Definition.Tasks {
		taskID := item.ID
		checks = append(checks, struct {
			name string
			id   string
			get  func() error
		}{"task", taskID, func() error { _, err := d.Tasks.Get(ctx, taskID); return err }})
	}
	for _, check := range checks {
		err := check.get()
		if err == nil {
			return drift(check.name+".id", "deterministic id is already owned by another record")
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return fmt.Errorf("check diagnostic %s id: %w", check.name, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (p Provisioner) createFixture(ctx repository.Context, languageIDs map[string]int) error {
	d, f := p.Dependencies, p.Definition
	access := domain.LessonReadAccessGuest
	visible := false
	createdCourse, err := (course.CreateCourse{Courses: d.Courses, Publisher: discardEvents{}, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, course.CreateCourseInput{ID: f.IDs.Course, Slug: f.Slug, CatalogVisible: &visible, LessonReadAccess: &access})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create diagnostic course: %w", err)
	}
	for _, language := range f.Languages {
		text := f.Course[language]
		if _, err := (course.UpsertCourseI18n{Courses: d.Courses, CourseI18n: d.CourseI18n, I18n: d.I18n, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, course.UpsertCourseI18nInput{CourseID: createdCourse.ID, I18nID: languageIDs[language], Title: text.Title, Description: text.Description}); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("create diagnostic course translation: %w", err)
		}
	}

	moduleStatus, moduleVisibility := domain.ModuleStatusActive, domain.ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly
	createdModule, err := (moduleuc.CreateModule{Modules: d.Modules, ModuleI18n: d.ModuleI18n, I18n: d.I18n, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, moduleuc.CreateModuleInput{ID: f.IDs.Module, Status: &moduleStatus, Visibility: &moduleVisibility, LessonReadAccess: &access, Translations: moduleTranslations(f, languageIDs)})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create diagnostic module: %w", err)
	}
	if err := (course.AddCourseModule{Courses: d.Courses, Modules: d.Modules, CourseModules: d.CourseModules, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, course.AddCourseModuleInput{CourseID: createdCourse.ID, ModuleID: createdModule.ID, Order: 1}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("place diagnostic module: %w", err)
	}

	sectionStatus := domain.SectionStatusActive
	createdSection, err := (sectionuc.CreateSection{Sections: d.Sections, SectionI18n: d.SectionI18n, I18n: d.I18n, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, sectionuc.CreateSectionInput{ID: f.IDs.Section, Status: &sectionStatus, LessonReadAccess: &access, Translations: sectionTranslations(f, languageIDs)})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create diagnostic section: %w", err)
	}
	if err := (moduleuc.AddModuleSection{Modules: d.Modules, Sections: d.Sections, ModuleSections: d.ModuleSections, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, moduleuc.AddModuleSectionInput{ModuleID: createdModule.ID, SectionID: createdSection.ID, Order: 1}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("place diagnostic section: %w", err)
	}

	lessonStatus := domain.LessonStatusNoActive
	createdLesson, err := (lesson.CreateLesson{Lessons: d.Lessons, LessonI18n: d.LessonI18n, Tasks: d.Tasks, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, lesson.CreateLessonInput{ID: f.IDs.Lesson, Status: &lessonStatus, LessonReadAccess: &access, Translations: lessonTranslations(f, languageIDs)})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create diagnostic lesson: %w", err)
	}
	if err := (sectionuc.AddSectionLesson{Sections: d.Sections, Lessons: d.Lessons, SectionLessons: d.SectionLessons, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, sectionuc.AddSectionLessonInput{SectionID: createdSection.ID, LessonID: createdLesson.ID, Order: 1}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("place diagnostic lesson: %w", err)
	}

	createTask := task.CreateTask{Tasks: d.Tasks, Lessons: d.Lessons, TaskI18n: d.TaskI18n, TaskTests: d.TaskTests, LearningTargets: d.LearningTargets, Publisher: discardEvents{}, StructureRes: d.CodeStructures, Tx: d.Tx}
	for index, fixtureTask := range f.Tasks {
		if err := createDiagnosticTask(ctx, createTask, createdLesson.ID, fixtureTask, languageIDs, index+1); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	activeLesson := domain.LessonStatusActive
	if _, err := (lesson.UpdateLesson{Courses: d.Courses, Lessons: d.Lessons, LessonI18n: d.LessonI18n, Tasks: d.Tasks, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, lesson.UpdateLessonInput{LessonID: createdLesson.ID, Status: activeLesson, Translations: lessonTranslations(f, languageIDs), LessonReadAccess: &access, LessonReadAccessSet: true}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("activate diagnostic lesson: %w", err)
	}
	activeCourse, catalogVisible := domain.CourseStatusActive, true
	if _, err := (course.UpdateCourse{Courses: d.Courses, Lessons: d.Lessons, Publisher: discardEvents{}, Tx: d.Tx}).Handle(ctx, course.UpdateCourseInput{CourseID: createdCourse.ID, Status: &activeCourse, CatalogVisible: &catalogVisible, LessonReadAccess: &access, LessonReadAccessSet: true}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("activate diagnostic course: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func createDiagnosticTask(ctx repository.Context, createTask task.CreateTask, lessonID string, fixtureTask FixtureTask, languageIDs map[string]int, order int) error {
	typeValue, purpose := fixtureTask.Type, fixtureTask.AssessmentPurpose
	execution, evaluation, ui, submission := fixtureTask.ExecutionMode, fixtureTask.EvaluationMode, fixtureTask.UIMode, fixtureTask.SubmissionMode
	requiresSandbox, exposesPreview := fixtureTask.RequiresSandbox, fixtureTask.ExposesPreview
	exposesTerminal, supportsLiveValidation := fixtureTask.ExposesTerminal, fixtureTask.SupportsLiveValidation
	targets, err := normalizeTargets(fixtureTask.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("normalize diagnostic task targets: %w", err)
	}
	if _, err := createTask.Handle(ctx, task.CreateTaskInput{ID: fixtureTask.ID, SourceKey: fixtureTask.SourceKey, LessonID: lessonID, Translations: taskTranslations(fixtureTask, languageIDs), LearningTargets: targets, Type: &typeValue, AssessmentPurpose: &purpose, ExecutionMode: &execution, EvaluationMode: &evaluation, UIMode: &ui, SubmissionMode: &submission, RequiresSandbox: &requiresSandbox, ExposesPreview: &exposesPreview, ExposesTerminal: &exposesTerminal, SupportsLiveValidation: &supportsLiveValidation, Order: order, Tests: taskTests(fixtureTask, languageIDs)}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create diagnostic assessment task %d: %w", order, err)
	}
	return nil
}

func (p Provisioner) verify(ctx repository.Context, courseRecord domain.Course, languageIDs map[string]int, structureID string) (Result, error) {
	d, f := p.Dependencies, p.Definition
	if courseRecord.ID != f.IDs.Course || courseRecord.Slug != f.Slug || courseRecord.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive || !courseRecord.CatalogVisible || courseRecord.MainTechID != nil || !hasAccess(courseRecord.LessonReadAccess, domain.LessonReadAccessGuest) {
		return Result{}, drift("course", "status, catalog visibility, access, or identity differs")
	}
	translations, err := d.CourseI18n.ListByCourse(ctx, courseRecord.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic course translations: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesCourseTranslations(translations, f.Course, languageIDs, f.IDs.Course) {
		return Result{}, drift("course.translations", "translations differ")
	}
	modules, err := d.Modules.ListByCourse(ctx, courseRecord.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic modules: %w", err)
	}
	if len(modules) != 1 || modules[0].ID != f.IDs.Module || modules[0].Status != domain.ModuleStatusActive || modules[0].Visibility != domain.ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly || modules[0].TechID != nil || !hasAccess(modules[0].LessonReadAccess, domain.LessonReadAccessGuest) {
		return Result{}, drift("course.modules", "expected one active course-only module")
	}
	moduleTexts, err := d.ModuleI18n.ListByModule(ctx, f.IDs.Module)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic module translations: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesModuleTranslations(moduleTexts, f.Module, languageIDs, f.IDs.Module) {
		return Result{}, drift("module.translations", "translations differ")
	}
	sections, err := d.Sections.ListByModule(ctx, f.IDs.Module)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic sections: %w", err)
	}
	if len(sections) != 1 || sections[0].ID != f.IDs.Section || sections[0].Status != domain.SectionStatusActive || sections[0].TechID != nil || !hasAccess(sections[0].LessonReadAccess, domain.LessonReadAccessGuest) {
		return Result{}, drift("module.sections", "expected one active section")
	}
	sectionTexts, err := d.SectionI18n.ListBySection(ctx, f.IDs.Section)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic section translations: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesSectionTranslations(sectionTexts, f.Section, languageIDs, f.IDs.Section) {
		return Result{}, drift("section.translations", "translations differ")
	}
	lessons, err := d.Lessons.ListByCourse(ctx, courseRecord.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic lessons: %w", err)
	}
	if len(lessons) != 1 || lessons[0].ID != f.IDs.Lesson || lessons[0].CourseID != courseRecord.ID || lessons[0].SectionID != f.IDs.Section || lessons[0].Order != 1 || lessons[0].Status != domain.LessonStatusActive || lessons[0].ComposeConfigID != nil || len(lessons[0].ComposeConfig) != 0 || !hasAccess(lessons[0].LessonReadAccess, domain.LessonReadAccessGuest) {
		return Result{}, drift("course.lessons", "expected one active lesson without runtime configuration")
	}
	lessonTexts, err := d.LessonI18n.ListByLesson(ctx, f.IDs.Lesson)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic lesson translations: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesLessonTranslations(lessonTexts, f.Lesson, languageIDs, f.IDs.Lesson) {
		return Result{}, drift("lesson.translations", "translations differ")
	}
	tasks, err := d.Tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, f.IDs.Lesson)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic tasks: %w", err)
	}
	if len(tasks) != len(f.Tasks) {
		return Result{}, drift("lesson.tasks", "task count differs")
	}
	for index, fixtureTask := range f.Tasks {
		if err := verifyTask(ctx, d, tasks[index], fixtureTask, languageIDs, structureID, index+1); err != nil {
			return Result{}, err
		}
	}
	return p.safeResult(ctx, courseRecord.ID)
}

func verifyTask(ctx repository.Context, dependencies Dependencies, actual domain.Task, expected FixtureTask, languageIDs map[string]int, structureID string, order int) error {
	taskType, _ := domain.ParseTaskType(expected.Type)
	execution, _ := domain.ParseTaskExecutionMode(expected.ExecutionMode)
	evaluation, _ := domain.ParseTaskEvaluationMode(expected.EvaluationMode)
	ui, _ := domain.ParseTaskUIMode(expected.UIMode)
	submission, _ := domain.ParseTaskSubmissionMode(expected.SubmissionMode)
	if reason := taskContractMismatch(actual, expected, taskType, execution, evaluation, ui, submission, structureID, order); reason != "" {
		return drift("lesson.tasks["+fmt.Sprint(order)+"]", reason)
	}
	if !matchesTaskTranslations(actual.Translations, expected, languageIDs) {
		return drift("lesson.tasks["+fmt.Sprint(order)+"].translations", "translations differ")
	}
	if !matchesTargets(actual.LearningTargets, expected.LearningTargets) {
		return drift("lesson.tasks["+fmt.Sprint(order)+"].learning_targets", "targets differ")
	}
	actualTests, err := dependencies.TaskTests.ListByTask(ctx, actual.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic task assessments: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesTests(actualTests, expected.Tests, languageIDs) {
		return drift("lesson.tasks["+fmt.Sprint(order)+"].assessment", "question or variant graph differs")
	}
	return nil
}

// taskContractMismatch reports only static contract labels. It is safe for an
// owner log and makes a real fixture drift actionable without exposing authored
// question or answer content.
func taskContractMismatch(actual domain.Task, expected FixtureTask, taskType, execution, evaluation, ui, submission int16, structureID string, order int) string {
	switch {
	case actual.ID != expected.ID:
		return "task id differs"
	case actual.SourceKey != expected.SourceKey:
		return "task source key differs"
	case actual.LessonID == "":
		return "task lesson is missing"
	case actual.Status != domain.TaskStatusActive:
		return "task status differs"
	case actual.Version != 1:
		return "task version differs"
	case actual.Order != order:
		return "task order differs"
	case actual.Type != taskType:
		return "task type differs"
	case actual.AssessmentPurpose != expected.AssessmentPurpose:
		return "assessment purpose differs"
	case actual.CodeStructureTypeID != structureID:
		return "assessment code structure reference differs"
	case !jsonEqual(actual.CodeStructure, domain.DefaultTaskAssessmentCodeStructure(domain.TaskTestKindSingleChoice)):
		return "assessment code structure differs"
	case actual.ExecutionMode != execution:
		return "execution mode differs"
	case actual.EvaluationMode != evaluation:
		return "evaluation mode differs"
	case actual.UIMode != ui:
		return "UI mode differs"
	case actual.SubmissionMode != submission:
		return "submission mode differs"
	case actual.RequiresSandbox != expected.RequiresSandbox || actual.ExposesPreview != expected.ExposesPreview || actual.ExposesTerminal != expected.ExposesTerminal || actual.SupportsLiveValidation != expected.SupportsLiveValidation:
		return "runtime capability differs"
	case actual.AllowedErrorsCount != 0:
		return "allowed errors differs"
	case actual.MaxAttempts != nil || actual.DeadlineAt != nil:
		return "attempt policy differs"
	case actual.ComposeConfigID != nil || len(actual.ComposeConfig) != 0:
		return "runtime configuration differs"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func (p Provisioner) safeResult(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (Result, error) {
	structure, err := (task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: p.Dependencies.Lessons, Tasks: p.Dependencies.Tasks}).Handle(ctx, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic course structure: %w", err)
	}
	catalog, err := structure.DiagnosticOnly()
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read diagnostic catalog: %w", err)
	}
	if len(catalog.Lessons) != 1 || len(catalog.Lessons[0].Tasks) != len(p.Definition.Tasks) {
		return Result{}, drift("diagnostic_catalog", "eligible task projection differs")
	}
	assessments := make([]AssessmentMetadata, 0, len(catalog.Lessons[0].Tasks))
	for _, item := range catalog.Lessons[0].Tasks {
		assessments = append(assessments, AssessmentMetadata{ID: item.ID, LessonID: item.LessonID, Type: item.Type, AssessmentPurpose: item.AssessmentPurpose, EvaluationMode: item.EvaluationMode, Order: item.Order, Version: item.Version, LearningTargets: item.LearningTargets})
	}
	sort.SliceStable(assessments, func(left, right int) bool { return assessments[left].Order < assessments[right].Order })
	return Result{Schema: resultSchema, FixtureID: p.Definition.FixtureID, FixtureVersion: p.Definition.FixtureVersion, CourseID: courseID, CourseSlug: p.Definition.Slug, CourseActive: true, CatalogVisible: true, CurriculumRevision: catalog.CurriculumRevision, Assessments: assessments}, nil
}

func resolveLanguages(ctx repository.Context, repo repository.I18nRepository, languages []string, create bool) (map[string]int, error) {
	ids := make(map[string]int, len(languages))
	for _, language := range languages {
		entry, err := repo.GetByLanguage(ctx, language)
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) && create {
			if err := repo.Create(ctx, domain.I18n{Language: language}); err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("create %s language reference: %w", language, err)
			}
			entry, err = repo.GetByLanguage(ctx, language)
		}
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
				return nil, drift("reference.i18n."+language, "required language reference is missing")
			}
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %s language reference: %w", language, err)
		}
		if entry.Language != language || entry.ID <= 0 {
			return nil, drift("reference.i18n."+language, "language reference differs")
		}
		ids[language] = entry.ID
	}
	return ids, nil
}

func resolveTestStructure(ctx repository.Context, repo repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository, create bool) (domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	const (
		id          = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000f900"
		code        = domain.CodeStructureTypeTestSingleChoiceBasic
		name        = "Single choice test"
		description = "Service type for single-choice test tasks."
		validator   = "ms-go-student"
	)
	structure, err := repo.GetByCode(ctx, code)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) && create {
		if existing, idErr := repo.GetByID(ctx, id); idErr == nil || existing != nil {
			return domain.CodeStructureType{}, drift("reference.code_structure_type."+code, "canonical reference id is occupied")
		} else if !errors.Is(idErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return domain.CodeStructureType{}, fmt.Errorf("check test structure reference id: %w", idErr)
		}
		descriptionValue, validatorValue := description, validator
		if err := repo.Create(ctx, domain.CodeStructureType{ID: id, Code: code, Name: name, Description: &descriptionValue, ValidatorService: &validatorValue, CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, time.March, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}); err != nil {
			return domain.CodeStructureType{}, fmt.Errorf("create test structure reference: %w", err)
		}
		structure, err = repo.GetByCode(ctx, code)
	}
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return domain.CodeStructureType{}, drift("reference.code_structure_type."+code, "required structure reference is missing")
		}
		return domain.CodeStructureType{}, fmt.Errorf("read test structure reference: %w", err)
	}
	if structure.ID != id || structure.Code != code || structure.Name != name || !sameOptionalString(structure.Description, description) || !sameOptionalString(structure.ValidatorService, validator) {
		return domain.CodeStructureType{}, drift("reference.code_structure_type."+code, "reference semantics differ")
	}
	return *structure, nil
}

func moduleTranslations(definition Definition, ids map[string]int) []domain.ModuleI18n {
	result := make([]domain.ModuleI18n, 0, len(definition.Languages))
	for _, language := range definition.Languages {
		text := definition.Module[language]
		result = append(result, domain.ModuleI18n{I18nID: ids[language], Language: language, Title: text.Title, Description: text.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func sectionTranslations(definition Definition, ids map[string]int) []domain.SectionI18n {
	result := make([]domain.SectionI18n, 0, len(definition.Languages))
	for _, language := range definition.Languages {
		text := definition.Section[language]
		result = append(result, domain.SectionI18n{I18nID: ids[language], Language: language, Title: text.Title, Description: text.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func lessonTranslations(definition Definition, ids map[string]int) []domain.LessonI18n {
	result := make([]domain.LessonI18n, 0, len(definition.Languages))
	for _, language := range definition.Languages {
		text := definition.Lesson[language]
		result = append(result, domain.LessonI18n{I18nID: ids[language], Language: language, Title: text.Title, Excerpt: text.Excerpt, Description: text.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func taskTranslations(item FixtureTask, ids map[string]int) []domain.TaskI18n {
	return []domain.TaskI18n{{I18nID: ids["en"], Language: "en", Title: item.EN.Title, Description: item.EN.Description}, {I18nID: ids["ru"], Language: "ru", Title: item.RU.Title, Description: item.RU.Description}}
}

func taskTests(item FixtureTask, ids map[string]int) []domain.TaskTest {
	result := make([]domain.TaskTest, 0, len(item.Tests))
	for _, question := range item.Tests {
		variants := make([]domain.TaskTestVariant, 0, len(question.Variants))
		for _, variant := range question.Variants {
			variants = append(variants, domain.TaskTestVariant{ID: variant.ID, SourceKey: variant.SourceKey, Order: variant.Order, IsCorrect: variant.IsCorrect, Translations: []domain.TaskTestVariantI18n{{I18nID: ids["en"], Language: "en", Text: variant.EN}, {I18nID: ids["ru"], Language: "ru", Text: variant.RU}}})
		}
		result = append(result, domain.TaskTest{ID: question.ID, SourceKey: question.SourceKey, Kind: question.Kind, Order: question.Order, Translations: []domain.TaskTestI18n{{I18nID: ids["en"], Language: "en", Title: question.EN.Title, Description: question.EN.Description}, {I18nID: ids["ru"], Language: "ru", Title: question.RU.Title, Description: question.RU.Description}}, Variants: variants})
	}
	return result
}

func matchesCourseTranslations(actual []domain.CourseI18n, expected map[string]Text, ids map[string]int, courseID string) bool {
	if len(actual) != len(expected) {
		return false
	}
	for _, language := range []string{"en", "ru"} {
		found := false
		for _, item := range actual {
			want := expected[language]
			if item.CourseID == courseID && item.I18nID == ids[language] && item.Title == want.Title && item.Description == want.Description {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesModuleTranslations(actual []domain.ModuleI18n, expected map[string]Text, ids map[string]int, moduleID string) bool {
	if len(actual) != len(expected) {
		return false
	}
	for _, language := range []string{"en", "ru"} {
		found := false
		for _, item := range actual {
			want := expected[language]
			if item.ModuleID == moduleID && item.I18nID == ids[language] && item.Title == want.Title && item.Description == want.Description {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesSectionTranslations(actual []domain.SectionI18n, expected map[string]Text, ids map[string]int, sectionID string) bool {
	if len(actual) != len(expected) {
		return false
	}
	for _, language := range []string{"en", "ru"} {
		found := false
		for _, item := range actual {
			want := expected[language]
			if item.SectionID == sectionID && item.I18nID == ids[language] && item.Title == want.Title && item.Description == want.Description {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesLessonTranslations(actual []domain.LessonI18n, expected map[string]LessonText, ids map[string]int, lessonID string) bool {
	if len(actual) != len(expected) {
		return false
	}
	for _, language := range []string{"en", "ru"} {
		found := false
		for _, item := range actual {
			want := expected[language]
			if item.LessonID == lessonID && item.I18nID == ids[language] && item.Title == want.Title && item.Excerpt == want.Excerpt && item.Description == want.Description {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesTaskTranslations(actual []domain.TaskI18n, expected FixtureTask, ids map[string]int) bool {
	if len(actual) != 2 {
		return false
	}
	for _, language := range []string{"en", "ru"} {
		want := expected.EN
		if language == "ru" {
			want = expected.RU
		}
		found := false
		for _, item := range actual {
			if item.I18nID == ids[language] && item.Title == want.Title && item.Description == want.Description {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesTargets(actual []domain.TaskLearningTarget, expected []LearningTarget) bool {
	want, err := normalizeTargets(expected)
	if err != nil || len(actual) != len(want) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range want {
		if actual[index].Type != want[index].Type || actual[index].Key != want[index].Key || actual[index].Version != want[index].Version || actual[index].Order != want[index].Order {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesTests(actual []domain.TaskTest, expected []Question, ids map[string]int) bool {
	if len(actual) != len(expected) {
		return false
	}
	for index, question := range expected {
		item := actual[index]
		if item.ID != question.ID || item.SourceKey != question.SourceKey || item.Kind != question.Kind || item.Order != question.Order || !matchesQuestionTranslations(item.Translations, question, ids) || len(item.Groups) != 0 || len(item.Variants) != len(question.Variants) {
			return false
		}
		for variantIndex, variant := range question.Variants {
			observed := item.Variants[variantIndex]
			if observed.ID != variant.ID || observed.SourceKey != variant.SourceKey || observed.Order != variant.Order || observed.IsCorrect != variant.IsCorrect || observed.CorrectOrder != nil || observed.GroupID != "" || observed.GroupSourceKey != "" || !matchesVariantTranslations(observed.Translations, variant, ids) {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesQuestionTranslations(actual []domain.TaskTestI18n, expected Question, ids map[string]int) bool {
	if len(actual) != 2 {
		return false
	}
	for _, language := range []string{"en", "ru"} {
		want := expected.EN
		if language == "ru" {
			want = expected.RU
		}
		found := false
		for _, item := range actual {
			if item.I18nID == ids[language] && item.Title == want.Title && item.Description == want.Description {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesVariantTranslations(actual []domain.TaskTestVariantI18n, expected Variant, ids map[string]int) bool {
	if len(actual) != 2 {
		return false
	}
	for _, language := range []string{"en", "ru"} {
		want := expected.EN
		if language == "ru" {
			want = expected.RU
		}
		found := false
		for _, item := range actual {
			if item.I18nID == ids[language] && item.Text == want {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func hasAccess(actual *domain.LessonReadAccess, expected domain.LessonReadAccess) bool {
	return actual != nil && *actual == expected
}
func jsonEqual(left, right []byte) bool {
	var leftValue, rightValue any
	return json.Unmarshal(left, &leftValue) == nil && json.Unmarshal(right, &rightValue) == nil && bytes.Equal(mustJSON(leftValue), mustJSON(rightValue))
}
func mustJSON(value any) []byte { result, _ := json.Marshal(value); return result }
func sameOptionalString(actual *string, expected string) bool {
	return actual != nil && *actual == expected
}
func drift(path, reason string) error { return fmt.Errorf("%w at %s: %s", ErrDrift, path, reason) }

type discardEvents struct{}

func (discardEvents) Publish(context.Context, string, any) error { return nil }
